items.label: f02-null-vs-or
items.front: What is the difference between value ?? null and value || null?
items.back: ?? replaces only null and undefined, so "" and 0 are kept. || replaces every falsy value ("" , 0, false, NaN, null, undefined). The target contact route uses ?? for name and email and || for phone and linkedinUrl.

items.label: f01-export-checks
items.front: List the checks GET /api/reports/export makes, in order.
items.back: requireAuthenticated (401), category in REPORT_CATEGORIES (400 Invalid category), users category forbidden for the user role (403), then the role-based report scope is built, then format: csv or pdf, else 400 Unknown format.

items.label: f03-enrich-route-order
items.front: In what order does POST /api/crm/contacts/enrich do its work?
items.back: Authenticate, validate the body (400), assertCanWriteContact (404), resolve API keys (402), load the contact (404) and require an email (422), create a RUNNING enrichment row, register the session in the in-memory map, then stream session, progress, result and complete events.

items.prompt: A manager calls GET /api/reports/export with no query string at all. What comes back?

choices.text: A CSV attachment named sales-report.csv
A JSON body listing every report category
400 Invalid category, since none was given
A PDF attachment named sales-report.pdf

choices: A CSV attachment named sales-report.csv
A JSON body listing every report category
400 Invalid category, since none was given
A PDF attachment named sales-report.pdf

items.explanation: category defaults to "sales" and format to "csv" through the ?? fallbacks, so the route builds the sales CSV and sets Content-Disposition to attachment; filename="sales-report.csv".

items.prompt: A user who signed up has userStatus PENDING and a valid session. They open any page under the authenticated routes. What happens?

choices.text: The layout redirects them to /inactive
The layout redirects them to /sign-in
The layout redirects them to /pending
The page renders with a pending banner

choices: The layout redirects them to /inactive
The layout redirects them to /sign-in
The layout redirects them to /pending
The page renders with a pending banner

items.explanation: AppLayout first redirects users without a session to /sign-in, then checks userStatus: PENDING goes to /pending and INACTIVE to /inactive. A pending user with a session therefore lands on /pending.

items.prompt: A user who may not write target t7 POSTs an empty JSON body {} to /api/crm/targets/t7/contacts. What does the route answer?

choices.text: 400 name or email required, from the body check
404 Not found, as the write check runs first
201 Created, with an empty target contact row
403 Forbidden, because the user lacks write access

choices: 400 name or email required, from the body check
404 Not found, as the write check runs first
201 Created, with an empty target contact row
403 Forbidden, because the user lacks write access

items.explanation: After authentication the route calls assertCanWriteTarget before reading the body; an AuthorizationError becomes notFoundOrForbiddenResponse(), a 404. The name-or-email check would only run for a caller who may write the target.

items.prompt: A cancel request for a running enrichment passes the ownership check. What status does the route write to the enrichment row?

choices.text: CANCELLED, with no error message stored
FAILED, with the error Cancelled by user
SKIPPED, with the error Stopped early
PENDING, so that it can be resumed later

choices: CANCELLED, with no error message stored
FAILED, with the error Cancelled by user
SKIPPED, with the error Stopped early
PENDING, so that it can be resumed later

items.explanation: After aborting the controller and removing the session, the route updates the row with status FAILED and error "Cancelled by user". There is no separate CANCELLED status in this route.

items.prompt: A permitted caller POSTs { "name": "", "email": "a@b.co", "phone": "" } to the target contacts route. Which values are stored for name and phone?

choices.text: Both empty strings are written exactly as they were sent
Both fields turn into null before the row is created
The empty name is kept as is, and phone becomes null
name is replaced by null while phone keeps its empty value

choices: Both empty strings are written exactly as they were sent
Both fields turn into null before the row is created
The empty name is kept as is, and phone becomes null
name is replaced by null while phone keeps its empty value

items.explanation: name uses name ?? null, and ?? only replaces null or undefined, so the empty string is kept. phone uses phone || null, and || also replaces "", so phone becomes null. The email makes the name-or-email check pass.

items.prompt: In generateCSV, a data row has name Smith, Jane and Number 3. How is that row written?

choices.text: Smith, Jane,3 with no quoting or escaping
"Smith, Jane",3 with the name in double quotes
Smith Jane,3 after the comma is stripped out
"Smith, Jane","3" with both fields quoted

choices: Smith, Jane,3 with no quoting or escaping
"Smith, Jane",3 with the name in double quotes
Smith Jane,3 after the comma is stripped out
"Smith, Jane","3" with both fields quoted

items.explanation: escapeCSV wraps a value in double quotes (doubling any inner quotes) only when it contains a comma, a quote or a newline. The name has a comma, so it is quoted; the number 3 has none of those, so it stays bare.

items.prompt: A user creates a contact and assigns it to themselves. Which side effects run?

choices.text: No email is sent; the audit log, event and revalidate run
An email is sent to them, and then the audit log is written
Nothing else runs, since self-assignment returns right away
Only the audit log is written; the Inngest event is skipped

choices: No email is sent; the audit log, event and revalidate run
An email is sent to them, and then the audit log is written
Nothing else runs, since self-assignment returns right away
Only the audit log is written; the Inngest event is skipped

items.explanation: The notification is guarded by assigned_to && assigned_to !== userId, so no email goes out for self-assignment. writeAuditLog, the crm/contact.saved Inngest event and revalidatePath run for every created contact.

items.prompt: getContacts() is called during a render for a visitor with no session. What does it return?

choices.text: It rethrows AuthenticationError to the error page
Every contact whose deletedAt is null, unscoped
A 401 response object built by the helper
An empty array, as the AuthenticationError is caught

choices: It rethrows AuthenticationError to the error page
Every contact whose deletedAt is null, unscoped
A 401 response object built by the helper
An empty array, as the AuthenticationError is caught

items.explanation: getContacts wraps requireAuthenticated in try/catch and returns [] when it throws AuthenticationError; any other error is rethrown. The page gate in the layout normally redirects first, so this is a second safety net.

items.prompt: A report category has no data in the chosen range. What does generateCSV return?

choices.text: The header row alone, with no data lines after it
It throws, and the route answers with a 500 error
The header row plus a single No data placeholder
An empty string, so the download is a 0-byte file

choices: The header row alone, with no data lines after it
It throws, and the route answers with a 500 error
The header row plus a single No data placeholder
An empty string, so the download is a 0-byte file

items.explanation: generateCSV joins the headers into the first row and returns just that when data.length === 0. Nothing throws, and no placeholder row is added.

items.prompt: createContact is called with birthday_day "4" and birthday_month "7" but no birthday_year. What is saved in birthday?

choices.text: The current year is filled in for the gap
null, because all three parts are required
"4/7", using just the two parts that exist
"4/7/", with the year left empty at the end

choices: The current year is filled in for the gap
null, because all three parts are required
"4/7", using just the two parts that exist
"4/7/", with the year left empty at the end

items.explanation: The birthday is built only when birthday_day && birthday_month && birthday_year are all truthy; otherwise it is null. No partial string is formed and no default year is used.

items.prompt: A permitted user starts POST /api/crm/contacts/enrich, but no OpenAI key resolves for them. What status does the route return?

choices.text: 400 with a validation error
200 with an SSE error event
402 with the error NO_API_KEY
503 Service Unavailable

choices: 400 with a validation error
200 with an SSE error event
402 with the error NO_API_KEY
503 Service Unavailable

items.explanation: After body validation and assertCanWriteContact, the route resolves the Firecrawl and OpenAI keys; if either is missing it returns NextResponse.json({ error: "NO_API_KEY" }, { status: 402 }) before creating an enrichment row or a stream.

items.prompt: A user with role user requests GET /api/reports/export?category=users&format=xlsx. What does the route answer?

choices.text: 200 with an empty CSV that has only a header row
403 Forbidden from the users-category role check
400 Invalid category, as users is not exportable
400 Unknown format, since xlsx is not supported

choices: 200 with an empty CSV that has only a header row
403 Forbidden from the users-category role check
400 Invalid category, as users is not exportable
400 Unknown format, since xlsx is not supported

items.explanation: users is a valid category, so the category check passes; the next check rejects category users for the user role with forbiddenResponse() (403). The format is only looked at after that, so the unknown xlsx format is never reached.

items.prompt: The app runs on two replicas. A cancel request DELETE /api/crm/contacts/enrich?sessionId=s1 reaches the replica that did not start session s1. What does it answer?

choices.text: 400 sessionId required, as the id cannot be verified there
200 success, after it aborts the session on the other replica
404 Not found, since s1 is not in its in-memory map
409 Conflict, because the session belongs to another process

choices: 400 sessionId required, as the id cannot be verified there
200 success, after it aborts the session on the other replica
404 Not found, since s1 is not in its in-memory map
409 Conflict, because the session belongs to another process

items.explanation: activeSessions is a process-local Map. On the other replica activeSessions.get(s1) is undefined, so the route returns notFoundOrForbiddenResponse() (404) and nothing is aborted. The code comment and the senior guide both say to use Redis for multi-replica deployments.
